title: Law to require paid-for disclosures on political social media posts
summary: This bill would require campaigns and independent spenders to include "paid for by" disclosures in political content posted on websites, apps and social media, similar to rules for other ads. It also directs the Campaign Finance Board to issue guidance on how disclosure, recordkeeping and reporting rules apply to such online content, including posts by paid third parties. The law would take effect immediately upon passage.
